Aircraft

A first look at FishFinder

A small, glanceable traffic display. This demo recreates the Pi experience with synthetic flights around O22, E45, KCPU and O27.

  1. Watch the moving ownship, aircraft trails and projected tracks.
  2. Single-tap an aircraft or airport to inspect it.
  3. When controls disappear, double-tap the display to bring them back.
  4. Try ranges, map brightness, altitude filtering and track-up versus north-up.

Green: outside the model’s horizontal reach. Yellow: potential proximity. Red: within 1 NM and closing. Gray: vertically separated under the observed-rate model. These are demo indications, not collision-avoidance guidance.

On an iPad

Open this link in Safari. To give it its own icon, use Safari’s Share menu → Add to Home Screen. After a complete first load, this demo can cache its local assets for offline use; check the cache status below the display before disconnecting.

No live Stratux, location access, analytics or automatic feedback upload. The local map has limited coverage; this is not a sectional chart. Airport information is a dated demo snapshot, not current operational information.
